title: Weighting system
story: As an operator, I want configurable category weights so the overall score reflects chosen priorities.
description: Provide a configurable, documented category-weighting system that supports named weighting profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Weights loaded from config, not hardcoded
Overall score = documented weighted aggregate of categories
Subjective priorities (e.g. fairness, political acceptability) are expressed via named weighting profiles, not category scores
Named weighting profiles are supported and none is presented as objectively correct
